summary: Plain kerb where cars park, near units 18 m away, steep.
reasons: Units 17-18 m away on own side

best_section.where: North kerb of Payne Street, west end opposite the corner house yard

drivers.seclusion: Residential units 17-18 m from the kerb on its own side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked at the kerb here; room to stop in line with them.
drivers.traffic: Street runs down towards a busy arterial with shops; local traffic is light at the west end.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked at this kerb; no sign of campers.

flags: Steep: about 9% at the best section, mean 7.7%
Noise from the arterial road at the east end
Homes within about 25 m on both sides
sun_shade: Open to the sky; units on the north side shade the kerb in the morning.
